prompt: Use case: website background asset, photorealistic fine-art editorial backdrop. Create one horizontal 16:9 seamless-feeling full-bleed background for a romantic Vietnamese couples memory website. A quiet golden AUTUMN AFTERNOON, warm low-angle sun illuminating a pale linen/ivory textured surface (#F2EDE6). Strong atmospheric autumn feeling but restrained saturation: honey sunlight, soft apricot, muted amber, warm cream. Delicate out-of-focus maple foliage and golden leaf bokeh visible ONLY at the far upper-right and far upper-left corners, soft diagonal dappled leaf shadows across the ivory ground, warm luminous haze. The center and the entire left-middle 65% must be extremely low contrast, bright pale ivory and usable behind dark serif typography. Very subtle photographic depth; corners can show a few warm copper leaves in soft focus but no dense piles. Keep bottom edge pale cream, not dark. No sharp tree trunks, no buildings, no people, no book, no phone, no table edge, no text, no logo, no frames, no buttons. Do not draw a web page. No strong orange wash over the entire frame, no saturated red leaves behind the text. Rich realistic soft light, organic shadows, no artificial glow or radial blobs. Large horizontal landscape canvas.
